name: Ethereum
description: Ethereum is a public blockchain launched in 2015 by a multi-person founding team.
methodologyNotes: Research-only and unranked. Primary sources establish the founding team, crowdsale, and genesis allocation, but do not attribute current founder-controlled wallets. name: Uniswap

methodologyNotes: Research-only and unranked. name: Solana
description: Solana is a public blockchain developed by a founding team assembled around Solana Labs.
